description: Image Description: The image showcases a vibrant and festive arrangement of a kumquat tree adorned with numerous bright orange kumquats and lush green leaves. Interspersed among the fruit and foliage are red decorative tags, each featuring golden Chinese characters and intricate designs. The most prominent character on the tags is "福" (fú), which means "good fortune" or "blessing," commonly used during Chinese New Year celebrations.
